title: Data Quality & Incident Response
description: Build the on-call discipline that production data engineers live by: where to place quality checks, how to detect silent data loss and corruption, and how to contain a schema-drift incident under live load.
outcomes: You'll place null and freshness checks where they catch problems early, distinguish silent data loss from late arrival, run incident response on data-corruption and schema-drift events without flying blind, and design statistical anomaly detection that scales beyond per-row asserts.
